title: Account Prioritizer and Scope Sprint Canvas
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: Sales and Customer Success receive a high volume of enterprise feature requests that are inconsistent in signal quality and missing sizing/context. This ticket delivers a lightweight, repeatable artifact (the 'Account Prioritizer + Scope Sprint Canvas') that CS/Sales can use to aggregate asks for an account or cohort, produce a one-page scoping envelope, and surface a prioritized recommendation to PMs for a quick decision. The canvas balances business value, implementation complexity, compliance risk, and alignment to platform themes (runtime performance, dedicated capacity, private deployments).
acceptance_criteria: CS/Sales can complete the canvas in under 30 minutes for a single account bundle
Canvas outputs a recommended next action: 'Investigate', 'Prototype', 'Build (MVP)', 'Backlog', or 'Decline'
PMs can triage a bundled canvas in a 20-minute sync and record a decision in Linear
The canvas includes a standardized rough-estimate grid (S, M, L) with key assumptions and dependencies
At least two pilot accounts from Sales complete the canvas during the pilot week and provide feedback
scoping_rubric: Value axis: revenue expansion potential / strategic account dependency / regulatory urgency
Effort axis: engineering points (S/M/L) + infra ops integration complexity
Risk axis: data residency, compliance, security, and rollback difficulty
Confidence: 3-question checklist (customer-provided acceptance criteria, sample traffic, success metric)
initial_estimates: Prototype (non-prod): 3-6 PTs for 2-4 weeks depending on infra dependencies
MVP Build: 8-20 PTs across runtime and console teams over 6-12 weeks (varies by quantization/ops work)
recommended_next_steps: Run 1-week pilot with two accounts (Sales owners: Priya & Mateo) using the canvas to bundle open asks
Collect 5 completed canvases and schedule a 30-minute PM review slot to validate decision heuristics
Refine rubric based on pilot: tighten revenue thresholds, add pre-filled templates for common ask types (analytics, RBAC, scaling)
Create a small Confluence template & quick-record Loom explaining how to fill the canvas
Hand off to ENG/Design for 'investigate' tickets with linked prototypes and success metrics
